app.name: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition
app.coder: Super Mario 63: Enhanced Wii Edition contributors
app.long_description: v0.4.1 staged correction release. Adds source-timed swim strokes and repeated spins, preserves backward backflip impulse/facing, and corrects ordinary jump pose selection. Optional private player.art supplies original Down/swim poses and bare backflip/triple animation exports. Authentic FLUDD/water composites and equipped variants remain incomplete. Same controller buttons; hold Spin to repeat when source rules permit. No yellow spin squares, terrain changes or Level Designer.
